dog.description_text: Are you looking for two adorable brothers to join your family? Milo and Teddy are about 2 years old and life has changed a lot for them. They went from living in a home with many other cats to figuring out how to feel comfortable in a shelter. Luckily, when they were placed back together, they seemed to feel much better. They are both a little shy but are described as sweet and affectionate once they're comfortable. They just need to find their forever home together to show their true selves!
dog.name: Milo
